FAQ

Common Questions

Chat on WhatsApp
What services does Robotrick offer?

We offer innovative educational programs and training kits, set up educational labs, and provide schools with custom technical curricula. We also support university students and institutions with technical consultations and professional automation solutions that serve their projects and grow their work.

Do I need prior experience for training programs?

Not at all! Our training courses are designed for all levels, from complete beginners (ages 6+) to advanced learners. We start from the fundamentals and build up systematically.

Can you build custom technical projects for businesses?

Absolutely! We specialize in custom robotics solutions, automation systems, and IoT projects. Contact us to discuss your specific requirements and we'll design a solution tailored to your needs.

How does Robotrick support graduation and innovation projects?

We provide specialized engineering consultations, supply electronic parts and prototypes (Prototyping), and train students to turn the idea into a real project.

Do students receive certificates upon course completion?

Yes! Students who successfully complete their training program and final project receive an official Robotrick certificate recognized across Syria.
